text:
On a work trip, my team and I picked this spot for lunch because it was close to our hotel. Service was ok and food was decent. Nothing spectacular but it got the job done. 

We were sat in a booth that was too small for our group which wasn't much fun. 

If you go, try the bread pudding made from donuts. Super sweet and satisfying!

We've been here at the GSR for a week now, and have dined at the Grand Cafe multiple times (breakfast/lunch or dinner 1x day). The food is delicious and we've tasted just about half of the menu so far. Portions are great, and although you do have to ask for typical sides that is priced separately- it's worth it in my opinion. The host/servers all wear masks and make sure diners are wearing theirs as well if not actively eating or drinking. As of July 15th - they're unable to seat more than 6 people at a table regardless if you're in the same party, so they'll stagger tables or split your party into x amount of tables to accommodate. Waitresses bring pre filled small cups of ketchup/hot sauce or ranch to your table along with individually wrapped packets of salt + pepper. On our last day here for dinner (07/16/20) our waitress Saima served us and is the absolute best! Just the sweetest & most attentive waitress we've had, ever. She went above and beyond to serve us, and was literally a perfect fit for our family! We're a big family (party of 6) and she knew from serving us previously the day before that we constantly ask for refills. So what did she do? (AND remember) She offered to bring multiple beverages at once, and even when those were empty - she brought more without us having to ask. We LOVE that! Her overall positive, happy attitude radiates and shows in everything she does. She deserves a raise and I would hope any patron dining here realizes how amazing she is. We co

Not quite sure what my family did to offend but the service here is deplorable.  We were instructed to seat ourselves (on the patio) and are literally being ignored.  Not sure why we're even still here.  

Oh, the waitress did bring us menus and water, but does not know how to greet her customer.  

What is even going on here?  I'm ready to drop some money on this "highly acclaimed" neighborhood eatery, but not even a "Good morning!"?

Can someone please help me understand?

Hands down the WORST dining experience I've had at a melting pot restaurant. We came in with a reservation and had to wait at the hostess stand for 5 minutes while she stared at the computer. During our first course, the cheese, did not melt. The liquid separated from the cheese and was not warming up. We raised the temperature on the burner ourselves because our waiter Joshua was MIA. When the cheese pot was removed, something must have overflowed onto the burner and continued to burn resulting in a horrible smell which stayed with us for the rest of the night. We had a longer conversation with the bus boy than our actual waiter. When we informed the waiter about the issue with the cheese, he excitedly offered to add fries onto our main course. We declined the offer. The drinks we ordered upon arrival were never bussed off our table until we asked to speak with the manager at the end of the night. After sharing our experience with the GM, she returned with two $15 discount cards which expired in 3 months. Needless to say we left them on the table and will not be returning.
Everything we ordered was fresh and delicious.  The service was friendly and quick, making our experience exactly what we were there for: great, fast, flavorful and authentic Cuban cuisine.

This place is just ok. There are so many better options around town for Mexican. I've never been really impressed with the food, prices or service. Again, it's just ok. I prefer Grand Hacienda, or the hole in the wall joints up 49th St.

Update...

They have added more items to their buffet every day, and its all delicious! 

I work literally down the street. My co-workers talk about this place quite often. Late lunch, starving, wanted something quick and fast. The restaurant is pretty spacious, but the buffet area needs more space. It has good selections, just cramped in a corner. Love that fresh naan is dropped to our table. Everything was delicious! I'm not an Indian food connoisseur so I can't tell you if it's authentic or not. It was just good. And at $10 per person, that's a deal!

Dined in.  Food was excellent as was service.  Was there around 2:00 in the afternoon and not very busy at that time on Saturday. Crawfish Etouffee was just like I used to eat when I lived in Louisiana.

We make a nearly annual trip to NOLA, and absolutely love trying to new places to eat. We just went to Mambo's yesterday, (our first stop after arriving) and had in incredible meal and outstanding service. The Red Beans and Rice along with the Jambalaya were some of the best we've had. Our server was Stacy, and she was amazing. So friendly, so helpful, and gave us the run down of what was happening in the area for the upcoming weekend. Generally, we only hit a restaurant once on each visit, as there are so many great places to go, however we're heading back to Mambo's again today....it's that good!

We've ordered twice this week hoping that the first delivery was an off day. I'm sad to say that this place has gone down hill and Papa Johns delivers better quality than Brooklyn pizza.  What was once my favorite, the lasagna, isn't any better than the frozen stouffers lasagna that you can get in the freezer section or those .99 cent Michelina's. Let's not forget that the delivery driver left off my side salad. Do yourself a favor and bypass this location. I'm sure they'll try to blame the decline on Covid like so many other businesses but twice in one week is a little ridiculous.

My fav is the sausages!  Tonight my guest & I delighted in an d fr dude of sauerkraut, cucumber Salas & cheesecake after our decedent meals (I had the smoked sausage, she had a scrumptious noodle dish.). The warm spiced wine brought the meal to perfection!  

(I've been here multi times before... & I've always found the service genuine but casual, & the enviro warm but also with elegance.

You will find the young & old equally delighting in this establishment!



Note:  while gluten & lactose free options are limited... I've found the ingredients to be of such quality... I've personally had minimal reactions upon having a bite or two of the food I shouldn't have... 

Another Update- moves to 5 stars as r staying safe during Covid 19 & the food is still phenomenal!
Great food! Great customer service! Great atmosphere! Great place for lunch or brunch with amazing prices! Worth every penny!

During these quarantine-times, Randazzos is one of the places I know I can trust for quality and consistent pizza to get here in a timely manner. Their staff continue to work hard and I have not gotten a wrong order yet. Every order has arrived hot and on days I'm too tired from working 12-13 hour shifts at the hospital, I rest assured knowing Randazzo's continues to be a steadfast pillar of quality food in our community.

Can't comment on the actual food or servers, but need to express how careless the evening staff and security guards are. 

I was here a few Saturday nights ago celebrating a friend's birthday. For those who don't know, this place turns into a very busy bar with a dance floor during weekend evenings. Around 1:30 am I realize I had just left my phone in their restroom about 5 minutes prior, and was told by a security guard watching the closed door that I was not allowed back in to look for it. I spent the next 15 minutes until close asking any employee for help, and was told I couldn't look for it and the most they could do was "give me a call in the morning". A few minutes after 1:45 am I was getting frustrated, kept trying to walk to the bathroom to look and was physically picked up and carried out of the building. Went home to check Find My iPhone to see my phone was still on and was still in their restaurant. 

Came back the next morning and was met by a super nice female manager who helped me look around the entire restaurant, still with no luck. By the time I got back home after our search, I was getting notifications that my phone was being located at a nearby campus and had officially been stolen. 

I know this place is in the city and I know that people (including myself) need to be more careful with their belongings, but it needs to be known their nighttime staff only cares about themselves, their money, and their own time. Hold on tight to your belongings if you go.

This is a fun spot. They're open 365 days a year, they have a special Thanksgiving lunch/dinner on Thanksgiving for a very good price too. They have a live music bar, a game room bar, & bar that you just chill and relax. Yeah, 3 bars. I come here often and I'll keep coming back. Oh and any food I've had from here on the past has always been good.
Really like this place! The food was delicious--nice selection on the menu. The staff is attentive and friendly and the place is very nicely decorated. Highly recommend.
Delicious food. Great Hospitality. Will return to try more items on the menu. Thankful that Reno has authentic Italian meals in a relaxing atmosphere.

Back in February we visited Rebirth for the 2nd time and were just as delighted as we had been on our 1st visit.  The cuisine here is cooked in the classic cajun style; contemplating the menu, you can almost imagine yourself visiting the warm and welcoming kitchen of an old Cajun grandmother ;-)

Tip: While everything I've tried here is exceptional, the dish that stands out most in my memory is the gumbo; it's the best of it's kind I've enjoyed in NOLA to date.  Last time I had one it was so amazing that I almost ordered a second one for dessert ;-)

The portion sizes here are nothing short of ginormous; when you eat here it would be wise to arrive with a large appetite.  The service is top-notch, and they also have a very impressive selection of cocktails AND a good wine list.

The venue is fairly small so given the quality of the cuisine I strongly advise that you make reservations; every time I've been here it's been VERY busy.

Delicious!! We are new to the area and used to live near some unbelievable pizza places. Dino's pizzas are delicious and have great choices of toppings. The crust is crunchy on the outside and chewy on the inside. The pizza is just as delicious left over, cold or warmed up!
A family favorite for dine in and takeout.  We always order the FGBLT and deviled eggs every brunch!  Lemon Ricotta pancakes are incredible too.  Great service and atmosphere.

Very authentic Turkish food and friendly staff. Great interpretation of the falafel wrap. The baklava was one of the best I have had and I have had my share. Highly recommended (both the restaurant and especially the baklava)
Great place to watch a game with a group. The food was what you would expect for a sports bar. Loved the wings! Overall good good and great atmosphere for a game.

I wrote a 5 star review when they first opened and loved this place. Over the past couple years their quality has been going down but I've eaten here because I like the chill vibe and support local businesses. 

Unfortunately tonight was the last straw to update my review. Got two pickup pizzas, both of which were undersauced and not good at all. I ordered the NTP and added pepperoni and jalapenos for an upcharge. If you look at my picture, it's a sad attempt at putting on toppings. Chewy, overcooked, undersauced, and probably the worst pizza I've had in a long time. 

I really hope they revamp the food quality here and address the issues. Until then go to Emmy Squared or Za.

Overpriced for what you get, I guess your paying for atmosphere? The floors and most tables were not cleaned up. Service was horrible. Waiter hardly came to the table. Someone else brought food. We sat on empty cups of water looking for him over and over. I'd much rather go to rock n sake.

*** let me be clear, i don't care that i can't sit outside i'd rather go home anyway. but don't pretend it's because you care about the safety of your customers or workers when its clearly not. you really care? MAKE PEOPLE WEAR FACE MASKS. simple. also pay your workers more....chipotle can afford to! 

Management won't force customers to wear a mask putting other people at risk (and yes you are allowed to deny service for this) but will threaten to call the cops (lol) if you eat outside (which you're allowed to do) even if you are social distancing.

They are pretending to care about their employees and customers health but aren't doing anything more than not allowing you to sit outside of their establishment. They aren't forcing customers to stand 6 feet but act like they give a shit about anything other than making money (even though their employees aren't even getting a living wage or extra pay for exposing themself to the customers that come in without masks)

Stop acting like you give a shit and actually do something to protect those people that are trying to stay safe and still live a day to day life. 

Also cover your fucking fritas i'm sick of animal protein accidentally being mixed in. If
Wonderful atmosphere, great drinks, and good location. My guests fillet steak was wonderful and my strip was okay.

I went on Wed 7/15/2020 and was so happy to see them open as the location in Westshore was now closed.  I always loved them but unknown what happended on this day, I ordered takeout and ate in my car minutes after picking up a supposed Hot Cornbeef on Rye but it was cold, the bread broke apart (old) so I took the bread off and just ate the cold cornbeef with the pickle.  I then ordered about $40-$50.00 in the bakery. I love in Zephyrhills so when I got home to show my family the treats it was very disappointing as the éclair was hard as a rock and the custard inside was hard. The Cannoli was definitely old, the shell was very soft not crunchy and the cannoli crème inside was hard and a little sour. Threw out Cannoli and the Éclair. I also ordered 2 Napoleons and they were delicious and were fresh.... 1 pound of Apricot cookies with the chocolate and sprinkles and they were fresh and delicious.  Disappointed in my sandwich not as thick as prior orders, cold and bread not fresh at all.. The girls at the bakery were wonderful. I hope for a better experience next time.

Delicious food and healthy options!!!! The only thing is the weight time. We didn't know about the reservation ahead of time so we waited an hour! But it is a cool new place wish it was bigger with more staff!!

I visited this little Mexican restaurant after a trip to New Orleans. We were heading home after a side visit to Metairie and looking for something other than "Cajun/creole." Glad we found this place on Yelp! 
 
It's a small building, but had a nice courtyard for outdoor seating. There was a fire pit and heaters, but even with that it was too cold for us. Had it been warmer I would have loved to sit outside. We opted to sit at the bar to avoid the wait for a table. The bartender was great! I hate that I can't remember his name, but he was quick and attentive at a full bar. He was working by himself, so I was quite impressed.

They brought out chips and salsa, which were ok. The salsa was good but the chips could have been fresher. We took advantage of the free queso check-in offer and it was soooo good! It was thick and creamy (vs. thin and watered down which is what I see pretty often). Great flavor that wasn't too spicy. We also tried the "elote loko" which is basically Mexican Street corn in a bowl. I would order this again, but they were heavy on the mayo so next time I would just ask for lite mayonnaise because that's my personal preference.

I ordered the trio fajitas. I really enjoyed this dish! The steak didn't look appetizing - I thought it was going to taste like dry beef jerky, but surprisingly it was nice and tender. The other two meats, chicken and shrimp, were cooked perfectly. The typical accompaniments were served with it and all delicious. Be warned that the

The Kolache Kitchen is a GREAT addition to the Freret neighborhood & provides a super fast, easy breakfast option. I usually get 3 spicy smoked sausage Kolaches for a satisfying breakfast. They have some seating in the restaurant, but it is mainly a take out establishment. They also serve breakfast tacos, coffee, fruit kolaches, and more. I highly recommend The Kolache Kitchen to anyone looking for a high-quality, fast, & affordable breakfast on the go.

I've been here before for salsa night so decided to return tonight.  Never going back! When we entered, my friend and I sat at the bar and were given two glasses of water. I ordered tacos and a margarita which were pretty good. Salsa lessons began and I had a great time.  Afterwards I returned to the bar to close out my tab and asked the bartender for a glass of water.  I was told that on salsa nights they aren't allowed to give glasses of water, only bottles and then he walked away. I paid my bill while upset and confused due to the fact that 1. I had been given a glass of water when I first got there, 2. My friend had been given 4 glasses of water as he sat at the bar during salsa lessons, 3. Other people at the bar had glasses of water, and 4. If this really were the case the bartender should've offered me a bottle and told me how much it would cost instead of walking away. 

As I walked to the door I asked the hostess if there were any reason why I wouldn't be allowed to have a glass of water,  and she said no. I then asked for a manager. As the bartender saw this he called me over and said he was a manager and so was the guy outside and they decided on the water bottle rule. He then proceeded to argue with me over the issue. I have never been denied a glass of water at a restaurant especially after dancing and sweating for an hour and already spending money there.  Needless to say I won't be back to Lucha and will find a new place to enjoy salsa dancing. 

Additional not

Amazing food and even better people.theirbfood is always fresh, and made quick. I have never been disappointed. The people who work there are so nice, they make my day every time I stop in. Their spicy menu is great, the paninis are solid.

The funny thing about this place is it's a wing place but I think everything they have is better then the wing sauces...the extra hot is standard hot sauce heat and the liquid fire is just maybe a tad bit hotter. I personally like really spicy food so was not impressed by the wings. The burgers are good and just the right size the only issue of ordering online is you don't get all the options. Such as if you want ketchup,mustard or stuff like that you can't add it to the check list since it's not listed and you need to put it in the special instruction area

Pros: The food is really tasty. The flavors are good and the cooking is skillful.

Cons: I'm not sure where all the meat went, it's mostly pieces of bone and sauce - very delicious sauce. It's common to find inedible bone pieces, gristle, and crushed leaf bits in the food. Finally, it is expensive.

I really wanted to like it but will be trying somewhere else next time I want Indian food.

Mexican food is reminded me of Macayos it's an upgrade form Taco Bell but no taco shop. We were sat right next to a bunch of people when they had tables open and not many people of the other side. Waiter never got us refills on our drinks. We decided to go back a second time and give it another try for breakfast. Breakfast was better but too expensive for the quality of food. We don't go here anymore. Better places around the area with better Mexican food.

After coming to LouVino for both dinner and brunch, I will probably stick with brunch. We visited the first day they started serving brunch and were seated right away even though we didn't have reservations and a larger party. The large windows facing Mass Ave were great for people watching. Our server explained any questions that we may have had and kept coming back to check on us. Our table tried the fried green tomatoes and country doughnuts to start off with. They were both equally amazing and the vanilla sauce that comes with the doughnuts was a favorite. We also had carafes of mimosas. I ordered the pancake tacos which were so fluffy you couldn't hold them to eat like a regular taco or they would fall apart (which was not a problem). I wouldn't change a thing about my visit and can't wait until the next time.

I won't be coming here again during the pandemic. Our food server was wearing her mask under her nose and there were customers walking around the restaurant without masks. Some of the employees seemed diligent but the whole staff has to participate in safety measures for the restaurant to be safe. A manager was there and should have been enforcing safety rules. I'm sad because this is one of our favorite neighborhood restaurants,

Please, for everything that is important and sacred, order the 'andre' - a secret dog, not on the menu, pioneered by a man clearly before his time. Andre, and 'the andre', is a reminder that there is still good to be found in this cold cruel place.
Every bite was excellent! Our groups of four ages 18-44 were all happy with our choice!

Was in town for a family event and went to Turn for breakfast. The food was amazing, the atmosphere great, and the waitress was super attentive. The record wall is an awesome touch and great conversation piece. Will definitely be going back next time I'm in town again.

I came here with a friend for drinks on evening recently (in COVID-era). They always have outdoor seating so they are well organized for this. The drink menu was diverse and the cheese board that we got was very nice both in taste and looks. Usually I would frequent an establishment like this for drinks during happy hour but we were really happy to come out to support this local business.

Our waiter was very friendly and kept a safe distance from us at all times. I felt safe from a health standpoint and their menus were paper/disposable.
Excellent service and food. Carne secs enchiladas were amazing. Thank you for the great memory.
Just got two beef and cheddar croissant sandwiches.  They were a big soggy mess. The  croissant was so soggy it was mush. No thanks, in the trash they went.

CAN'T COOK A STEAK
I am sorry but it is not hard to cook a steak to the proper temperature. Three of us ordered medium rare steaks and all got over well. Besides that, one person was upset about the portion size on the fish. Many enjoyed the clam chowder. The service was not terrible but also not great. Overall I would not recommend this restaurant to someone and won't be back.

Wow.  Came to New Orleans for a work meeting and am staying at the W across the street.  Given the decent Yelp score, my co workers and I decided to give this place a try.  BAD. IDEA.
All 3 of us left most of our luke warm, dried out food on the plate.  From the pancakes to the french toast--it seemed as if they were made earlier and reheated (barely) in the microwave leaving them luke warm and rubbery.  The eggs were cold and overdone/dry.  They were out of cream for the coffee and the espresso machine wasn't working.  Really.
The only decent thing, according to my co workers, were the grits which were "ok but not great".
Unless you are drunk from the night before and have ZERO ability to taste anything and don't care--then you will be OK coming here.  If you are sober and looking for at least a GOOD and DECENT breakfast, then move along and don't even try coming here.
Trust me.

I LOVE Upland! Champagne Velvet beer? Bomb. Bad Elmer Burger? Off the chain! 

I'm an IU kid so Upland is a treasure down there. The fact that it's now in the Indy area, I couldn't be more thrilled. It's also dangerous because I live so close to it. I've never been disappointed with any of their beers, dishes and atmosphere. I'll be returning since this is one of the restaurants that I truly love!

The best Mexican food in all of Tucson, honestly. I've seen this place posted all over the Tucson Foodie blog for some time and it was always on our "places to tey" list. Coincidentally, on Cinco de Mato, we happened to be near the restaurant and decided to check it out. Since the actual restaurant was bot permitted to dine-in at that time, we stood in line for their food truck that was put in the parking lot. It was pretty much a standard wait time for a food truck (especially when they are making real food on-the-spot) and the prices were incredibly affordable. They packed everything up and gave us a ton of their various salsas to try. When we got home, we couldn't believe how good everything looked and it tasted even better. I honestly can't pick a favorite thing that we had (pork adobada, carne asada, chicken caramel, some weird but amazing taco cooked inside a chile). We will definitely be back in the future.

I've always loved Metro Diner and one of my friends had never been so we went today! It's always packed on Sundays but we only had to wait about 10 minutes  to be seated since there were only 3 of us. We got cinnamon pancakes,avocado toast with eggs, and  bacon egg and cheese croissant with hash browns . Everyone's food was delicious and the portions here are massive so it's easy to share everything with a Group. Also bonus the mimosas here are also massive and they're only $2.99 all day! You can't beat that with brunch!

I'll start with the positive: the Samosas were edible, I'll go as far as to say they were good.  Now the rest: the chicken tikka masala was not good - it tasted like they dumped sugar in the sauce, and the chicken was very dry/not edible.  The naan tasted like it was a few days old; it was so stale and hard that I couldn't even rip it into pieces without a struggle.  I would definitely not eat here again.  The only way I'd order again is if I decided I just wanted samosas and was driving by and wanted to pick up a snack.

food was great! waitress was very attentive! the margarita de maya was delicious and so were the nachos and sandwiches!! loved it here and would definitely come back. was a little pricey tho!! very nice date for me and my girlfriend:)
The food was delicious. Very clean, and the staff were welcoming. Free parking and they're on Grubhub. I highly recommend Taste of Dubai.

Best gyro in Indy? Quite possibly. I used to eat here once a week when I worked on the West side. Now I make sure to stop when I'm out that way. The lamb is always fresh and juicy, not that dry junk from their competitors. The tzatziki is great and I always order extra.
Food quality and service have dropped. We used to be regulars for dinner and drinks.  Now we go to Crabbys just every once in a while.  Better places in Westchase for food / drink / service.

Homestead used to be our favorite burger place. We would never go in and sit down to eat though because the noise level is unbearable. You can't hear the people at your own table talking. We were fine getting our food to go. 

The last 4 times we have ordered online they have messed something up. Our order is not hard and we have no customizations to our burgers. They always forget to include the ranch and fry sauce. There shouldn't be a spot in the online ordering section that asks what condiments you want if they aren't going to include them. On multiple occasions my husband's mushroom Swiss burger had uncooked mushrooms instead of sautéed or there will literally be 2 mushroom slices on it. 

Last night was the breaking point. I am 35 weeks pregnant and all I wanted was the BBQ burger. We ordered online as usual and my husband picked it up. Upon opening my to go box I was instantly disappointed. I instantly noticed there was no fry sauce and my burger was wrong as well. There was maybe 4 drops of BBQ sauce on the burger and it had clumps of seasoning all over. The most irritating part was there was no onion ring on it, which is of course my favorite part.  

If you like a super loud restaurant with less than friendly staff or having your order messed up then this place is for you. Otherwise I would look elsewhere.
Hidden little gem in south Tampa and they're open for lunch! Great meal, great atmosphere, great service and great sanitation!!!!   Thank you

I absolutely love this place so much. I've been here probably three times in one month and I just can't get enough I just can't get enough and I'm fully supporting this beautiful family's business bon appétit.

Was worried I wouldn't find a good BBQ place around this area, but Wister's is consistently delicious. The pulled pork and brisket especially, but also many other items. The curbside pickup on Main Street is extremely convenient combined with online ordering, never had to wait when picking up. I also find their prices to be pretty fair given the quality of the food (and time it takes to make), along with the amount of food you get. Definitely check them out.

I found this restaurant by accident when I pulled in to turn around in the little strip mall parking lot and decided to get a quick carry out lunch.  Being in somewhat of a hurry I just took a brief look at the menu and quickly ordered one of my favorites, basil fried rice with tofu. 

The employee was very pleasant, and in about ten minutes she brought my order to me.  It was nicely packaged and definitely a large portion of basil fried rice.  

The vegetables were bright and crisp, cooked perfectly.  Broccoli, sugar snap peas, bell peppers, onions and plenty of basil.  Tofu was nicely done as well.

I plan to stop back soon and try the pan mee noodles, which are hand made in-house.
Do you like decent Ethiopian food with a wide variety of beer in a chill, relaxed atmosphere? Then Era is for you. Check it out and you won't be disappointed.
What a great place in downtown Palm Harbor. Our daughter demands a stop each time we take the golf cart out. Keep up the amazing flavors.

Had the best experience last night at Green Hills Grille. Spur of the moment decision to have dinner here and so glad we did. Fabulous service, server and great food. If you go, ask for Jon A, he was so fun and made for a great evening. The manager was very in touch and just as fabulous.
My fiancé and I recently moved into the area and we LOVED jalapeños. Now with a larger space and a full bar, it's still the same great food and service.

I was just in Philly visiting for the weekend and we had a phenomenal group dinner here! The restaurant is super trendy with cool mood lighting, and felt like it could have turned into a club at any point. We went all out and did the 7-course tasting menu, where you get to pick 1-2 items from each category (somehow, we were all able to come to a consensus as a table on what items to get). This was very reasonably priced at $45/person and a good way to try a lot of dishes. Note: if you have any vegetarians in the group, they can do a vegetarian tasting menu for that person or let them opt out and just order a la carte, which I thought was very accommodating. 

Now for the dishes! Here's what we enjoyed from most to least:
- Amazing: waygu beef (absolutely melts in your mouth), crispy rock shrimp (super crispy with just the right amount of sauce), XO scallops (seared perfectly), crispy brussel sprouts (couldn't stop eating) 
- Great: peking duck (with yummy scallion buns, but you have to eat it quickly or else the duck gets a bit tough), seafood dumpling (nice chili sauce), edamame dumpling (very unique and can definitely taste the truffle, but paled in comparison to the ones I had at Buddakan the night before)
- Average: shrimp pad thai (a little too much sauce, nothing mindblowing), roasted broccoli (a bit plain)

They finish off the meal with 2 types of soft serve ice cream cones, which were orange creamiscle and chocolate cherry our night (I think it rotates). Definitely re

Great precautions during Covid. They took our temperature by a scanner machine near the door, then seated us outside. Natalie, the hostess, accommodated us by seating us under a heater outside so we were quite comfortable. She was sweet and attentive, keeping her distance and wearing a mask which I was grateful for.

 The restaurant is not open for inside dining at this time,  but upon checking in, I could see the bar would have been so much fun  Quite a selection of alcohol from what I could see.

Hospitality and festive is the feeling upon arrival.  Music coming through the windows above our head was not too loud but made for some entertainment, We were greeted quickly by our server, Travis, who was absolutely adorable and quite energetic. He not only knows food, but alcohol and was helpful in sharing some ideas for touring Philly. He too wore a mask the entire time (properly too I might add).  

Food was delicious.  We started off with a variety of drinks, then the appetizers arrived.  Raw oysters from an organic farm off the Jersey shore. A cheese plate and fried pickles.  Fried pickles --- I was thinking "why did someone order that?" But they were crisp and flavorful. Apparently they are famous for their grilled cheese and tomato soup - Delish. I think the red onion jam really makes the sandwich.  And, the salmon dish was just  amazing. Crisply cooked on the outside and not overdone on the inside. Can't recommend it enough. If the butternut squash is in season, order it.

Anyone that know me, know I love taking pictures of my food. However my burger didn't have a chance to become an internet star. That burger was so delicious and huge. I'm ashamed to say I ate the whole burger in one sitting. My entire work team ordered and you heard no talking. All you heard was ummmm ummmm! Thank you lees for a great lunch!!! See you soon

Beautiful decor! Lobster nachos were soooo good! The carnitas Chimichanga was not crispy at all but the pork on the inside was ahhhh-mazing! Wife got a steak dish with shrimp and fried potatoes that she was obsessed with. Overall I'd give it 4.5/5 stars!

What a delightful twist on pizza!  I love Indian food, but I wasn't sure how mozzarella would meld with Indian spices and flavors. Pleasantly surprised, to say the least. Absolutely delicious. The crust was amazing, and the normal icky pizza grease was nonexistent. Give 'em a try!!!

I was excited to see a new Greek restaurant open in Tucson. Great looking restaurant, the service was good. Waiter was attentive and polite. The food was fast but we were also early so place was empty. The complimentary hummus, tazatiki, pita and cucumbers was a nice touch. The food portions were huge but this is where they lost me. I had a gyro wrap and there meat was mushy not crispy. There were barely any veggies in the wrap. The French French fry portion was huge. We had Avgolemono Soup the flavor was good but the rice was mushy as it was on my gyro wrap plate. I was disappointed in the soup, I have had better. The calamari was yummy, not chewy but definitely way to much fried stuff on top, so when the out lemon juice on top it became soggy. So to sum it up, rice,  meat and to much fried batter thumbs down. The rest was good. If those things were fixed I would give it another shot. Being that they are new restaurant maybe they are still working perfecting items? Let's hope!

So my husband went to get chicken tonight at 5:30. After placing his order and paying for it he was told they were cooking the chicken and it would take 15 mins. My husband said he would go wait outside and come back in 25 mins. to pick up his order. 15 mins later he went in to pick up his order and was told it would be 25 mins. They were just dropping the chicken. They offered him original recipe instead, which we do not like, or he could wait 25 mins but they do not refund payments! The man standing beside my husband was complaining his order was completely wrong!! Definately have some problems running this store if you sell chicken and at dinner time you have NO chicken....... thinking we will not be back

If you haven't tried this downtown gem just north of Washington Ave on 6th St, you owe it to yourself to do so. Finally made it there today, and the service, food, and the space did not disappoint. I had the Farmer's breakfast platter with eggs, bacon, sausage, pork belly, fried potatoes, and a biscuit with sausage gravy any southern grandma would be proud to serve. My wife had the BLT loaded with a half pound of the good stuff. Great choices with a nice bar selection. Friendly, attentive, and appreciative owners and staff.

First time ordering, and was so pleased to see they delivered to Ewing (via a delivery app). First off, I have a severe egg allergy and I wasn't immediately sure if they were completely vegan. It does say "plant based," but I've been burned before, and most of the things I was ordering had "aioli" on them. So I thank them for putting up with my neurosis as I wrote "anaphylactic egg allergy" under every item I ordered. They wrote a note to let me know that they are 100% vegan, plus gluten and nut free as well, and take allergies very seriously. This is much appreciated, and is not as common as you might think. So thanks!

I ordered the street spuds, chili spuds, spicy chipotle tacos, tofu scramble flatbread, a ginger, strawberry, and cucumber infused water, as well as a mint & blueberry infused jasmine green tea. The chili spuds were missing from my order--too bad because I was looking forward to trying the chili, but not a big deal. I was refunded and had an abundance of other food!

Of the drinks, I would recommend the infused water. I can taste each of the flavors, and it's super refreshing on a warm, humid day. The jasmine green tea wasn't steeped for long enough, I think. I can taste the mint and an aftertaste of blueberry, but not the tea. As a tea lover, I want to taste the tea!

The food was all wonderful. The delivery was fast and the food was still warm when it arrived. Everything had bright, robust flavors for a healthy, filling, delicious meal that left me feeling

Decided to give this place a try on my first visit to Trolley Square! I ordered a vegetarian gyro which came for fries. WOW, the gyro def hit the spot and fries were nice a crispy. I would 100% stop by this place again. It was also quite busy amidst COVID season during lunch time. I highly recommend!

I'd say this is my go-to spot for great pizza. I could order any pizza on their menu and be happy with it, whoever crafted the menu hats off to you. But it doesn't just stop there, the appetizers...wow. Extra brownie points for using Amelia's amazing sourdough bread with their meatballs, love it!

We ordered delivery which came timely yet again. Chix piccata was perfect. I loved that they sort of batter fried the chicken beforehand.  Perfect amount of capers, seasoning, lemon, etc. the sides were ok too.  The gravy was a little sweet for the veal parmigiana but hey some people like it like that.  Still the best little Italian place in the area!

What a refreshing establishment to grace the Nashville scene. While D'andrews isn't really a hidden gem, at least it shouldn't be at this point, the quality and sophistication of these baked good feel like they don't belong here. The presentation and flavor profiles scream New York City. Disclaimer I'm not baker and I've only been to New York a handful of times.

But yeah it shouldn't take much to convince people of great pastries. Hop on their instagram to see the specials for the day. You won't be disappointed. Oh also I've never experienced any of the more cafe style options, but the sandwiches smelled great when I popped in for pick up.

Easily the worst pizza shop in Hockessin. The cheesesteak crust is very bland has like 0 flavor it's a very dry pizza. The garlic knots are a tad overrated, usually I just get soggy soaked knots if I've ordered them. Today I tried the cheesesteak absolute joke. So I've heard bad things about the cheesesteak before how it's a small like dinky sandwich. And wow people were spot on, the sandwich is only like 10 inches so already under the typically footlong standard. It is 8.25 it makes sense now. It is made with the pizza dough. I got it and literally I thought there was no cheese on the steak. The cheese was melted into the roll with the steak put on top of it. What a absolute joke of a sandwich. I mean the absolute worst. 2 cousins has a attitude even with the employees thinking they'e the best. Nope not even close

*UPDATE EDIT: the owner and her sister met with me today to discuss the situation and are dealing with employees in question who ignored the staff mask policy in place and made light of the situation. They stated that staff is, in fact, required to have masks on and the issue will be addressed with the offending staff.

This is my Favorite sushi spot in all of Boise!! I have been on the hunt for a year to find a good one and this one meets it! The owner is so friendly and the rolls here are amazing. My favorite is the baked salmon roll. I think it's the hidden gem of sushi in Boise! Highly recommend!

The oysters were sizzling when they came to the table! Absolutely delicious! A short line during COVID but I'm sure it will be longer when things get back to normal. The food is so good you will be well rewarded for any wait!

Kevin already has a reputation in town for being a bit of a curmudgeon, which I can certainly confirm. The upside of the new location is that he has an employee working with him, so they can offer delivery while the shop's still open. Kevin should really have his assistant answer the phones, since it's clear (from my experience and other reviewers' testimony) that he doesn't enjoy talking to people and patiently explaining options. 

A cat goes in and out of the restaurant at will; I'm not sure how they get away with a clear FDA violation. There's ample patio seating for folks who want to pick up pizza and eat it there, but no table service.

The pizza sauce is a little bit chunky, and in true St. Louis style the cheese is provel and sparingly applied. All in all the pizza's not bad, and ordinarily I'd want to frequent a locally owned shop, but so many other businesses are struggling and actually trying to treat all people decently, so Kevin's isn't a go-to for me.
Best Mediterranean food in Boise. Everything on the menu is delicious, fresh and well-prepared. Very kind staff. I would go there once a week if they had a Meridian location.

Muy sorprendida Por la comida, excellent, riquisima, todo spectacular. Lo mejor de todo fue el Servicio, nos atendio Camilo, educado, gentil, muy atento.
Los felicito.

Sumo Sushi will always be my go to. The staff is so friendly and their food is amazing. I order delivery from them probably every other week and they're always on time and the sushi never disappoints. They even throw in extra food on the house. Last but not least their prices are more than reasonable.
Excellent breakfast and brunch spot. On the weekends, be prepared to wait a bit. Regardless it is worth the wait

Good place for the buffet. Food is hot and usually the pans are pretty full. Price is decent and there are not many Chinese buffets in town, that are good and less expensive. Never orders off the menu so no idea what the story is with that.
Awful. Barely any meat on the gyro and the meat that was on it was chewy and inedible. Very disappointed.

I have been a loyal customer since 2016. Best sandwish in my opinion is the wednesday special "meatloaf"
They use Cuban bread and freshness is always present. Please Note that THEY DELIVER!!!!!!!!, normally delivery is from 1pm but accomodations are being made thru "corona virus" challenging times. 
Promote local business, the owner are long time residents of the area. 
PS: Empanadas are aweome too! 
Yadi D.

In my opinion, Nachomama's is the best Tex-Mex in St Louis by a long shot. In fact,​ it's as good as my favs in Austin, Texas. It's owned and operated by a wonderful local family as well.

I sincerely recommend Nachomamas if you are in the mood for Mexican​ or tex-mex.​

Great addition to the Ciccio Restaurant Group. Very different concept in terms of vibe and menu. But, as per usual excellent food. Many options to choose from all with the fusion of Cuban and Mexican cuisine. A bar restaurant combo. Very cool accents and touches in the anterior as well as a lot of seating. Also, tried the cubano "sangwich" which was a very interesting but yummy twist on the classic Cuban. The sampler platos look great as well as the loaded nachos. Will definitely be back and bring others here. Cool atmosphere with great food. A very welcome addition to Soho.

I had relatively low expectations coming in but I'm a fan!  Got the Persian wrap. Super simple...  chicken, rice and spicy ranch. It's delish!  Had to get a boba of course. I went with the grape and lemon tea. I really loved this. It's refreshing and sweet but not overly so. The only thing I'd say id that the boba are slightly undercooked (too hard). That said I really enjoyed my lunch here. A pleasant surprise!
Picked up a pepperoni pizza from here, the first taste of pizza since March. Everything I'd dreamed of! So satisfying.

We ate here while we were in town for an interview and really enjoyed the food! Everything we had was great. The bbq and sauces were wonderful, and they have delicious fries and Mac-n-cheese. They give free cheddar biscuits/rolls, which are cheesy and sweet and so good. Loved that the environment is sit down, but relaxed and has a bar and tv's! We will be back if we are back in the area!

I am so happy we stopped in! The proprietor, Guido, greeted us at the door and cheerfully welcomed us in to his restaurant, where the ambiance is classy and the service is top-notch. We dined here for lunch and ordered the Taormina and Bologna, along with wine (barbera d' asti). The Taormina presentation was unique and unexpected, and fully delivered on flavor. The Bologna was also very flavorful, with a level of richness that made the dish. Truly delicious! The wine was a nice pairing for both dishes, and there are amazing wines to choose from on the list. We will definitely be back!
Great happy hour, tooo
Very very good... everytime i go to los olivos and santa barbara and many places up the coast its worth to stop.   Will not be dissapointed.  I like the pastor and  carnitas... you have to try it...

This restaurant is a surprise in that it looked to be for tourists and clearly wasn't. The people dining here included local residents, college crowd as well as tourists like ourselves. We dined here twice during our week stay in Santa Barbara and had terrific meals both times. The service was excellent and the food very tasty. Seafood always is expensive so when you can say it was worth paying for the meal, that says it all for me. Cioppino was  especially tasty. I also recommend the risotto with scallops.

Was looking for some quick food at PhL when I came across this place. Now me being vegetarian I usually pass by any burger places but today was not that day. 

My kids would be happy with a snack so the order of fries and tots (yes they have tots!) would make them happy.  They had a homemade black bean patty avocado burger. The burgers were $9 a pop and the fries tots and shake all cost me $30 which is pretty steep to me. The burger tho was great. The bun top notch and even tho the burger looked like dog food (no lie) it was super tasty and the avocado was good. My daughter (6) isn't a big avocado fan but she loved this.  

The fries were bleh and I wouldn't get again but tots were crispy and good.   Overall. Happy for the veg option rather than Pizza and Chinese.

I waited to write this review but after my four visit, I knew I had to share how much I love their sushi!

New Leaf 2 is barely a month old in Manayunk but quickly has become my most favorite place. Not only is the layout perfect - sushi bar then wrap around bar - but the staff is so friendly. Sharon in particular is lovely and attentive to her customers. 

Onto the food - my pictures speak for themselves! The sushi is fresh, beautifully presented, and SO delicious. I'm working through the whole menu, but so far my favorites are: Ninja Turtles and Green Lady rolls. They are each so flavorful and innovative. 

If you're looking for a quality place for awesome sushi in Manayunk, you MUST try this place. You'll be for a treat!
The Cajun Chicken is like a flavor orchestra in my mouth. Unbelievably good.

I love Drake's! They have live music and games and beer towers. I LOVE their Chicago roll. Most places do not have good sushi that use meat other than seafood; however I have to get this roll at least once a week now. Trivia is also a lot of fun! Highly recommend. I do miss the bleu cheese buffalo chips though!

Food was very good.  Eggs Benedict was delicious.  My husband had the meat skillet which he enjoyed.  I am definitely going again.  Yes it was hard to find, but on a Saturday around 12noon, I did not have to wait.  Food was also pretty reasonable.

Nice place tucked away but still close to the beach. Great selection of beer on tap, 34 local craft beers. Didn't eat the food but it looked delicious. Server was nice and friendly (don't see that too often anymore) and answered any questions we had. We will be back and recommend to anyone coming to Clearwater Beach.

The wait was entirely too long, waited over an hour and was told only 40mins. Had my nephew with me and then was told they only have high tops, i felt that accommodation should've been easily understandable and made for us instead of letting others sit at normal tables knowing I had a child with me.
The food was good and our server did her best to tend to us and get everything out fast as possible. She was very attentive.

There are two lines to get beignets here - one is to dine in and one is for take-out. Both lines move fairly quickly. These beignets don't disappoint and I believe they are definitely worth the hype! Its cash only so I recommend stopping at an atm beforehand if needed. They also serve really delicious cafe au laits and give ample amounts of powdered sugar that will get everywhere so be prepared, haha. Service is very fast and beignets typically take less than five minutes to be ready. Would recommend going!

We had a really great experience here. First, the whole vibe and decor of the place is just so cool and really thought through. If we hadn't had a table I would've been totally fine with sitting at the bar even. They also had a really slick little lounge area too. The food was delicious and different, even the sides were fun to try. Can't wait to go back!
First time going there with our daughter (vegan) and it was amazing! The bowl was great and baked goods the best vegan we have had eating out!

Stopped by with my family this morning, we are from out of town and next time we pass by we will be returning for sure . Great little diner , delicious food. A little long on the wait time but everyone , customers and staff extremely friendly , grits and pancakes were awsome !!!

Called ahead to reserve since we had a large party.  5min before the reservation time, they called our name.  I told the hostess that rest of the party was a block away.  She said no problem and that we'd be seated when they go there.  We all walked inside at the reservation time and they said it would 15-20min.  The wait turned into 45min.  Pretty much they gave our reservation away and tried to play it off.  All would have been forgiven if the food and service were good.  Unfortunately it wasn't the case.  We waited 15min for a glass if water, the appetizers cans our 10min apart with no plates.  A salad that was ordered came out after the entree and the 2 barbecue plates had cold meat on them.  Definitely not worth the wait.

The bald host guy is literally so rude and unprofessional. Basically assaulted my boyfriend for walking into the restaurant while we were putting our name in because he needed to go to the bathroom. He immediately freaked out and lost his temper saying "get out of here" and that he won't serve us now. Telling us that we are adults and need to "watch the news". This is all NEW to EVERYONE. Nobody inside the restaurant was wearing a mask so he thought it was okay to go to the restroom quickly. There is absolutely no reason to treat us the way we were just treated. So embarrassing and he needs to learn how to treat customers. Be better.

Best Mediterranean restaurant.
The food is always perfect and the service is great. Always make room for desert it is amazingly good!

The Good: Appetizers are delicious, dahi bhalla, sev puri, pakoras, pani puri. Tandoori items are also pretty good.
The Bad: I have ordered several times online. The staff totally disregards any requests to customize the dishes. What if you have allergies?
Then, the amount of oil in the tikka masala, especially the paneer tikka masala, is disgusting. I had to keep draining out oil from the takeout container and it still kept collecting on top. My kitchen sink turned red from pouring out all the red stained oil. But, I'd rather it go down the drain than clog my arteries. Ridiculous!!! This has happened two times, so I will never order this dish again. The malai kofta described as a creamy sauce in the menu was quite the contrary. It was also served in this awful oil filled mess. I think I will only order appetizers and tandoor from this restaurant.

OMG had the Dry Heat burger and Fries, yes yes yes delicious moist med rare burger and crunchy on the outside fluffy on the inside fries again yes yes yes delicious owner came by to check on me nice and polite not pushy get here ASAP can't wait to go back tomorrow nice clean establishment staff friendly and does there job without being bothersome yeah
Neyow's Hands down was the best food I had in New Orleans!! And the staff was excellent ass well!!
CLOSED!!  a tragedy, we LOVED Savalala, wonderful, warm, and a major league cook/chef. PLEASE reopen somewhere! The square in Lebanon?
Always pleasant, great food and consistent. I've been going there since they've opened and I have never had a bad meal. Large quantity.

Definitely trying times for any restaurant.  We got takeout after stay at home restrictions were lifted in St Pete. The restaurant is set up for Covid - employees separate from customers by plastic rap barrier.  No touch delivery.  Signs to instruct customers to pick up pens to sign receipts with a napkin.  I would have been nice to have a tap pad to pay. 

No seating, of course.  Take out only.  Staff was friendly and prompt in handling my phone order.

Food - its ok.  It's your basic take out, store front Chinese restaurant.  Nothing special.  We had some typical dishes - egg roll, dumplings, beef with garlic, chop suey, wonton soup, and chow mein.  No standouts.  Basic takeout.  Good, not great. But, in a pandemic, when your hankering for some Chinese take out, China Kitchen hit the spot.  

Thanks go to the staff and owners for working hard to be safe.  Good job.

Y'all  this place NEVER disappoints! Let start with the fried catfish. So flakey, so moist, so delicious! I started with the singe flavor but I've now worked up to the extremely hot flavor (On Fire!). Flavor is unmatched in Nashville! The wings (both jumbo and party) are EXCELLENT. They are very crispy & I usually get the lemon pepper flavor. My mouth is watering just thinking about it. ALL their sides are delicious but I'm a fan of Okra and the coleslaw! If you ever are in the Rivergate area this would be the first place I'd recommend.

I've bern here 3 times now. Sampled the moussaka, gyro, greek salad.  Everything is so fresh, prices are really reasonable.  Never a wait for a table.  Outdoor dining.  I highly recommend this greek little place.

After waiting 45 minutes to be seated,  I was totally disappointed.  Prior to eating there I read the comments and I was warned that the food wasn't good, however,  I gave them a try anyway. 
BBQ ribs were AWFUL with sauce plopped on top... Sauteed crab fingers had a bitter taste just like the prior comments stated.. 
Stuffed bell pepper wasn't the best, very soggy.. Such a wasted dining experience..
Love from Chicago, great high quality restaurant with great management. Love this place.

I've really been trying to support small businesses, but something was just missing here for me. Reviews were great, even talked to customers, but I couldn't get past the service. Started out good, a small taste of the brisket and corned beef. I explained I was ordering for 2 adults and a 7 year old. I had already ordered the pork loin sandwich and was told I needed to get another 2 lbs of meat. Come on, I said 2 adults and a kid. Really? I asked about the bread and was told I had to pay $.60 for two slices. I just came from Texas and bread was complimentary with the meat. Just sayin'. Needless to say, they forgot to give me the bread. I know about up selling, but it just didn't sit well with me. Didn't really enjoy the food as much as I should have, feeling like someone tried to pull one over me. Oh well, better luck next time.

Win win is an upscale Panda Express.  We had coconut shrimp as appetizers, mongolian beef, chicken mango, spring rolls.

Soda machine was out of Dr. Pepper but food was food.

Service was good.

We would come again.
Ordered the Pizzle, was a little different but delicious. Made order online, and they were out of requested bread, but they called to offer other options and also offered a free bag of chips.
Last night a small group of us came for dinner but the doors were locked. Lights were on but nobody home WTH!

Decent little Mexican shop and restaurant. The counter is directly in the back. The service was great with a bilingual rep taking our order. 

5 tacos: 2 steak and and two chicken. I had high hopes but they were just okay. Lacking flavor and the tortillas were not on the grill long enough. The sauces were above average. 

I am happy that we tried it out but in all likelihood will not return.
Monte Cristo and hot pastrami Ruben's are the best for me.  Door dash deliveries. Always fast clean delivery.  I'll order again

Our experience was amazing from start to finish. The guac, queso, and salsas were delicious. The seasoning wasn't over the top and very enjoyable. The chicken, steak, and fish tacos were incredible. We all had the seasonal and regular margaritas and were satisfied with the quality. To top it off, our server was awesome. We can't wait to come back.

This was my first and last time I will get food from the Better Box. The staff was very nice, but the food was not cooked well at all. Everything was burned, hard to chew, and the fries was so dry and chewy I just toss them in the trash. The flavor the rolls were there but was unbearable to eat because they were over cooked and very hard to chew. I would love to support this business, but after my experience it would be hard. The food is supposed to speaks for itself, well the Better Box food was not speaking to me.
Great meat lovers slice.  Best I've had on Bourbon St. Nice crust with plentiful cheese and toppings.

We ate there on a Friday at 7pm. We were surprised it was very busy. We placed our order to go, and I understand the place is new, but the ordering process was painful. 
We ordered the Duke and a Build your own. I don't like how the Build your own is SO MUCH more expensive for less toppings. We had 5 options, with one being cheese, and it was $13.50. It comes with ricotta and it was overpowering - just too much volume. There was hardly any onion and their spicy sausage is weird. It's like huge thick slices of summer sausage. Gross texture. Again to ordering they confused our sauces, didn't ring them up so I paid for another thinking they missed it. We ended up with an extra we didn't need.
The Duke has good fillings but the dough was undercooked. I made the mistake of curing into a few slices and the filling falls everywhere. 
The buffalo butter was the best but let's be real - it was like jarred buffalo sauce. I was expecting more of a spicy butter. But the flavor was good.
The house red was super basic, the spicy had more flavor.
The Duke comes with BBQ trance. It was super runny so not dippable and the flavor tasted like balsamic ranch.
For a place to out so much emphasis on sauces, I thought they were all lacking and need a major step up. 
We were excited to try several of the versions but I don't think we'll be back. 
Oh and the takeout took about 30 min. When it was ready, they don't call your name, or give you a card for your table so we saw our stuff sit there for abo

This restaurant is located inside the Vinoy hotel.  The outdoor seating is really nice and relaxing

However I found the service is very slow.  It took a while for the servers to take our orders, to serve our food and to get a check.  The quality of food is good, nonetheless.

ABSOLUTELY DISGUSTING!! the front counter person - order taker, cashier, packaged our order - had hair down past her waist, touching her butt - it was loose, blowing all over the place with her every movement. she continually flipped her hair back over her shoulder with her hand/arm, mostly left side unless she bent over and had to toss the hair hanging down (touching the floor, it was that long) on the right side back over her shoulder. she would also run her hands over her face then tuck the hair on the sides of her face behind her ears.  i told my partner i wouldnt even think of eating this food - bad enough in "normal" circumstances that her hair was all over the place and her hands all over her face... but  with covid going on right now?? NO WAY! 
i went outside to wait and told my partner when he came out with the order to put the bagged stuff in the trunk. when we got home i told him to put everything in the sink and dish out he wanted. i threw everything else  in the dumpster. 
and to top it off, partner said the meat was "a little cold" and he had to heat  it; the green beans just room temp; and the okra fried so crisp there was no "okra" inside the breading.
don't know what else to say except STAY AWAY FROM THIS PLACE!!

I think my problem was my excitement over the menu. I had high expectations. I was in a party of 4, all chosing a different dinner. the steak tacos were overflowing and enjoyed. the spicey tuna presentation was as expected, also enjoyed. I had the fish and chips. Half of the fries were soft and the slaw was incredibly under seasoned. the fish batter was light, but soggy in most areas- without lemon juice applied. We survived the night, but I'm not coming back right away.

I am so disappointed with this restaurant's management and customer service.  We ordered a pick-up order on 12/30/20 and we were early. When we got home which is about a 5 min drive, the margarita flatbread bruschetta was ice cold and the meatballs we ordered were not in the order. On 12/31 I called and talked to Manager #1 Jacob who promised to take the items off our credit card. This was never done. 1/22/21 Called and talked to Manager #2 Jerome who promised he would make sure he took care of the problem and the credit to our card. He also promised to send us some gift cards. Here we are on 2/3/21, twelve days later no credit has been processed to our card and we have not received any gift cards. It has been 34 days since my 1st call. SHAME ON YOU MAGGIANOS. TERRIBLE CUSTOMER SERVICE!!!

Still great, ljke always, per my prior review. In light of COVID, the owners and workers are adhering strictly to social distancing guidelines by clearing every other table, having PPE for workers, etc.

Sushi quality and timing has not changed at all, still delicious and incredibly filling. Definitely going to continue supporting for the foreseeable future.

What a delicious find!!  On our way up to Solvang for the weekend and stopped at Stearns Wharf to check out, trip around and have some lunch.  The place was packed except the bar.  We sat at the bar and had amazing and efficient service.  The food however, was the highlight!!  We each got something different and also didn't wanna pass up trying the mini lobster rolls, so got that also to try.  Everything was amazing!  Lobster rolls were flavorful, and light with capers, my fresh fish and shrimp ceviche had the right amount of citrus and oodles of avocado.  My friends had the ahi poke tacos and shrimp tostadas.  Both equally incredible with flavors.  Really light and fresh.  Wish we lived closer to try more, often!  A must try for sure!!

Just wanted to quickly update my review since my previous one is three years old.  We're still coming here, and still loving it!  A Cut Above has been especially great during Covid because we can pick sandwiches up and take them to a park to eat outside.  Great if you want to get outdoors with your quarantine pod or meet up for a socially-distanced picnic with a couple friends.  I recommend ordering ahead (it took 20 - 30 minutes the last two times I've ordered), and taking your sandwiches to Ridley Creek State Park which is nearby and has picnic areas.  The staff has been so friendly taking phone orders and ringing me up when I arrive.  They are also all wearing masks.

My new favorite sandwich has been the "Pork and Cheese" with a side of the fried long hots.  The roasted pork is so tender and juicy, and it has thin slices of roasted garlic that just take it over the top.  Definitely recommend!

Bad atmosphere, bad food. This used to be one of my favorite places in New Orleans. My $14 glass of wine had turned, also. I didn't mention it to the server because I felt awkward but for that price, I really should have. I know the wine was off because it was a brand I have had many times outside of this context so I know what it should taste like.  I'm guessing that the server used the last of a bottle that had been open for a few days. The reason I said that the atmosphere was bad is that there was very loud shitty pop music playing. And a group of young intoxicated people sat down next to me and were talking and borderline-arguing loudly too, which did not help. The type of music & its volume did not fit with the otherwise bohemian and romantic vibe of the place. Other than the obnoxious group, it was myself and a couple of other people there, who were each sitting alone at a table, too. I had wanted to read a book and enjoy a glass of wine (that had not turned bad) but the music was so loud and grating that I just left as soon as possible. Also, I ordered two food items and both were extremely unimpressive. Smoked salmon was just slapped on a plate with a few brown capers & like 3 arugula leaves. And it did not taste like high-quality salmon. "Fingerling potatoes" were strangely shaped, oily yet dry lumps with no flavor. Food used to be amazing here. They may have had a change of ownership and certainly, of kitchen staff. I hate to leave a negative review for this place
This restaurant is permanently closed! The owner decided to retire. It happened in the last week or so. Sorry to see them go from my neighborhood.

If you like gristle lettuce wraps, then this place is for you. My wife and I came here hoping for a good experience cooking meat ourselves and enjoying Korean staples. I was disappointed. The miso soup was solid, but things went downhill from there. The raw meat we cooked was tougher than a $2 steak. Frankly, I couldn't get past that one issue. This place has great reviews, but I just don't get it. Cook your own food and pay out the nose. No thanks.

RR has always been one of our go-to restaurants prior to the pandemic and it has always been great. We ordered take out earlier in the year and were not impressed. Given the pandemic and having to switch to take out only, we gave them a break. We've eaten there a couple times in the last 6 months but decided to do take out tonight and give it another shot. We were happily surprised. All food was still hot when we got it home, portions were large, just like in person dining. And food tasted great as well. We have done take out from a few restaurants in our area in the past 9 months since the pandemic hit and have not been impressed at all. Will happily order to go from RR in the future.

For the best experience, go in person during weekday lunch hour. That crew is always friendly, remembers my face and makes a great plate. 

Do NOT order through a delivery service. Your order will be wrong every time. You'll never get a salad dressing EVER. About half the time, your child's meal will not have a drink or side in the bag. It will be a regular occurrence. No one at the store or delivery service will care.

This place is top notch. The quality of the food and atmosphere are just what we were looking for. The menu is simple and approachable. This place is a must go to if you are in New Orleans. We went right when they opened at 11am and this avoided the line. There drinks are great as well!!

This was my first visit to Noodles & Company. We got our order to go. It was fairly busy but they did a good job of social distancing and all staff were wearing masks.
I got the Penne Rosa but substituted the any noodle cauliflower rigatoni. The pasta was tasty and had good texture. Standard portions and the price was reasonable. The food was not exceptional, hence the 4 stars. Plus I'm not crazy about the location. Next time we'll call ahead for our order to go. 
Note:  you have to ask for napkins and forks.

This used to be our favorite place to go on a weekend morning for a breakfast bagel. The wonderful gentleman working was always friendly and the bagels were delicious. 

One day he told us that he was going to start working at the Sarah's Bagels in Boise. Sarah's in Meridian hasn't been the same since.  

Due to negative experiences after that we haven't been there in 6-7 months. This morning we tried again. Two young women were working. Our order was easy - a cheese bagel, toasted, with veggie cream cheese. I was told they don't have veggie cream cheese. "It's on your list of cream cheese flavors," I told her. She shrugged and said they don't have veggie cream cheese anymore. Oookay. So I asked for regular cream cheese and avocado on a cheddar cheese bagel. She tried to give me the wrong bagel - I pointed at it and repeated the order, but she seemed confused. Then she forgot the avocado. They weren't busy. It took about 20 minutes and was really frustrating.  We are trying to give our business to local establishments, but man, Sarah's Bagels in Meridian doesn't make it easy.
BEST pizza in St Charles. Love the call ahead sitting. Wish they had a bigger location.

What a great place for regulars and new people to Clayton. Very warm and welcoming and very delicious crapes, muffins, avocado toast and much more a five-star breakfast experience. Please enjoy!
I love this place!

This was not a good experience overall. I should have left to another restaurant the moment I saw young kids smoking out front of the restaurant. The cashier was nice and gave me a review of most popular items so I'd like mention she did give me warm welcome. I chose the fried chicken bento box and was seriously disappointed. The chicken was very fatty, the sausage and the egg looked old. I don't believe I was served fresh food. Maybe a one off scenario since this was my first time but I ended up only eating the corn side and rice. I took my meal to go so I couldn't give them an opportunity to make it right. Because of the great reviews, I was expecting a better experience experience.
Restaurant OPEN. No longer open. Just open for catering. To bad because the food was good.

I had a terrible experience with Tina on the phone ordering a to go omelette. I have allergies so ordering food is hard already, Tina refused to help me figure out what I could eat. When I asked her if she could check on the ingredients of a gluten free bun for me she said, "no look it up yourself I don't want to walk to the fridge." She acted like my whole order was inconveniencing her. I work in the service industry so this was astounding to me that she cared so little. I love the food here but I would hope they make this right.

To say that we have become obsessed with the cheesesteaks here is an understatement. We live an hour away and have made the trek three times in the past three weeks. The fresh bread is a perfect vessel for the tender ribeye, grilled onions and cheese (your choice but we always go with whiz.) They have many sandwich options, crinkle fries etc. Don't miss out on this place!
